name: ULM-4B Serving Rollback v1
reason: Real-model smoke tests found weak dialect expression and a degenerate-response regression in the frozen v1.0 Arm B serving path. The earlier Arm A checkpoint is used only as a serving rollback; v1.0.0 remains immutable.
limitations: Dialect strength is prompt-based and is not guaranteed to be monotonic on every prompt.
The rollback restores an earlier, more stable serving checkpoint but does not establish native-speaker authenticity.
Strong lexical Ulsan forms remain limited; native-speaker evaluation and a targeted data pass are still pending.
